title: Greensleeves
short: Traditional English tune · Em 6/8 · play it with every note lit.

blocks.html: Count six eighth notes in each bar, in two groups of three. The tune is in E minor. Listen to the refrain: the first time it uses C-sharp (bar 9), and the second time C natural (bar 13), which gives it an old, gentle sound.

blocks.name: music-player
blocks.cap: Play it: the score scrolls, the keys or strings light up as each note sounds.

blocks.html: The piece: English song known since the 1580s; also the tune of the carol “What Child Is This?”

sources.name: Melody and bass checked note by note against the Mutopia Project’s “Greensleeves” hymn setting (SATB, from cyberhymnal.org; public domain). We use its top and bottom voices.
